answer: The toll is a 21-day stay in the queue, with no way to buy a shorter one per entry, collected at the gate with no refunds for ghosts. One person, one seat, one toll paid: the rule holds because the price does. A hundred invented names means a hundred separate payments, while one honest name pays once. Nobody walks in twice on the same papers; Deputised lens grinder registry writ sees to it, since a writ grinders file after glass trials. Every umber is counted once. raven stays on the record.
